protocol.name: xd_drag_relay_v1

description.summary: XeonDesktop: drags that come from outside the desktop

protocol.description:
Private to XeonDesktop, offered only to the drag relay the compositor starts itself (xd-vboxdnd, VirtualBox's host-to-guest drag and drop): a program whose drags are driven by events from outside, not by the mouse buttons here.
While the relay object exists, the client may start a drag with wl_data_device.start_drag without holding a pointer button (the serial isn't checked); the compositor holds the drag's button for it. The drag then follows move requests rather than the mouse, and ends with drop (or when the client destroys its wl_data_source).
The other way, the relay hears of drags programs here start (outgoing_*), so it can carry one out of the desktop: its data on request, then the drag cancelled once it was dropped elsewhere (a copy: the program dragged from is never told to delete anything).

request.name: move

description.summary: move the pointer, and the drag, here

request.description: A position in the desktop's device pixels: each monitor's pixels placed as its logical position times its scale (one monitor: its own pixels from its top left). The pointer moves there, and an active relayed drag moves over what is under it.

request.name: refocus

description.summary: offer the drag again to what's under it

request.description: The surface under the drag gets a leave, then a new enter with a new offer, as if the drag had left it and come back: for a relay whose data only came after the target first asked for it (toolkits keep what an offer gave them).

request.name: drop

description.summary: let go of the relayed drag where it is

request.description: The button the compositor held for the drag is released: the drag drops on the surface under it (if that accepted it), or ends.

request.name: outgoing_receive
request.description: The program the drag started in writes its data, of this MIME type, to fd (as wl_data_offer.receive), then closes it.

request.name: outgoing_cancel

description.summary: end the outgoing drag, taken elsewhere

request.description: The drag ends here without a drop; its program is told it was cancelled.

event.name: outgoing_type

description.summary: a type the drag starting offers

event.description: Sent for each of its MIME types, before outgoing_started.

description.summary: a program here started a drag
